parameters.formDescription: Paste up to 10 NSE/BSE symbols of non-financial Indian companies (for example IOC, RELIANCE, IDEA), separated by commas, spaces or new lines. Each company gets the 61 checks and a weighted risk score. You get one Excel file: a Ranking sheet (riskiest first, with change versus the last run) plus a detail sheet per company. Extra sources (screener peers and price APIs, NSE pledge data) are optional: if one is unavailable its checks show Not tested. Runs one company at a time, so allow about 20 seconds per company.
